about: Functional tests: harder or less common questions, to find what the copilot still gets wrong. Every expected value was looked up in the synthetic database or the policy documents. A list inside facts means any one of those values is enough.

cases.why: A denied claim still shows a service was done. M-00142 had a lower-spine MRI on 2026-09-12 (CLM-10482, denied), so 'no MRI in the past 12 months' is not met.
cases.question: Member M-00142 needs an MRI of the lower spine. Is prior auth required and do they meet criteria?

cases.why: M-00215 had a knee MRI on 2026-01-22 (CLM-10221, denied), inside 12 months. The knee X-ray on 2026-05-21 (CLM-11475) is older than 60 days.
